name: [🎣] My Fishing Island
desc:
BECOME THE ULTIMATE FISHERMAN in [🎣] My Fishing Island!!

🐟🌊 CATCH, RIDE, AND EXPLORE
Reel in unique fish and place them in your pond to generate MONEY over time—even while you’re OFFLINE!
Ride your biggest catches out to sea to discover EVENTS, TREASURES, and NEW ISLANDS!

❓HOW TO FISH:
• Cast your bait into the water
• Play the CLICKING MINI-GAME to boost your catch power
• After a short wait, your fish is automatically reeled in
• Add your catch to your pond to start generating passive income!

⭐ OFFLINE INCOME:
Your pond keeps earning MONEY even while you’re away—come back to collect your profits!

⚡ UPDATES every week with NEW fish, events, and islands!  
Follow the game so you don’t miss out!

💛 LIKE, FAVORITE, and JOIN the group + community server for EXCLUSIVE REWARDS!
